items.summary: Recommend preserving containment and rejecting any revenue, margin, ROI, forecast, or payback claim this cycle. Known evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21; all commission is unattributed to sites. AI usage records $1,002.45979265 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,531 calls, with 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Comparing these amounts would be misleading because periods and attribution do not align; nevertheless, the observed AI cost is materially larger than the only observed aggregate commission. Contribution margin, total infrastructure spend, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because non-AI direct costs, budget ceilings, period-matched revenue, and workflow-level outcome linkage are absent. Do not expand AI-heavy or monetization work until a read-only finance baseline records these gaps and the minimum measurements needed to close them.

Amazon attribution is only partially usable: 18 named tracking rows are mapped, but the 2026-09-21 provider aggregate contains 629 clicks, 28 ordered items, and $4.92 commission under an aggregate row that cannot be assigned to any site. Site-attributed income is $0. Do not convert named affiliate clicks, SEO impressions, sessions, or conversions into revenue claims. The minimum required evidence is a period-matched provider export where every new affiliate link uses its registered tracking ID and commission is attributable to site and content identifiers.

Please preserve the current no-expansion boundary while documenting the existing finance evidence gap. AI usage is observed at $1,002.45979265 for September 2026, but total infrastructure cost is unknown because operations sweeps have no results and the snapshot contains no hosting, egress, domain, storage, or other direct-cost ledger. The minimum report-only artifact is a period-matched cost table by site or workflow with source timestamps, observed AI cost, infrastructure cost fields, and explicit unknowns; do not change routing, billing, credentials, or runtime controls.
